name: Taxonomy
description: Adds a Taxonomy class extending Abstract_Taxonomy from rtcamp/wp-php-toolkit. Always multi-instance (one class per taxonomy).

inputs.description: PSR-4 namespace for the taxonomy class. Default 'Inc\Taxonomies' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-namespace (e.g. 'Acme\Blog\Taxonomies') to override.
Directory for the taxonomy file. Default 'includes/Taxonomies' matches the rtCamp skeleton; pass the project's actual sub-path to override.
PSR-4 namespace for the test class. Default 'Inc\Tests\Taxonomies' matches the rtCamp skeleton; override alongside 'namespace' for non-default projects.
Directory for the test file. Default 'tests/Taxonomies'.
Taxonomy slug (kebab-case, used as the key in register_taxonomy(), e.g. 'product-category').
PascalCase class name, derived from slug.
Post type slug(s) this taxonomy attaches to (comma-separated for multiple, e.g. 'product' or 'product,page').
Hierarchical taxonomy (like categories) or flat (like tags). Pass 'true' or 'false'. Default 'true'.

wiring.description: Instantiate the taxonomy so it registers its init hook. Taxonomies are always multi-instance. Insert in the plugin bootstrap alongside other taxonomy registrations.
